verses.ar: مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ حِينَمَا هَرَبَ مِنْ وَجْهِ أَبْشَالُومَ ٱبْنِهِ يَارَبُّ، مَا أَكْثَرَ مُضَايِقِيَّ! كَثِيرُونَ قَائِمُونَ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many [are] they that rise up against me.
verses.web: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

verses.ar: كَثِيرُونَ يَقُولُونَ لِنَفْسِي: «لَيْسَ لَهُ خَلَاصٌ بِإِلَهِهِ». سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Many [there be] which say of my soul, [There is] no help for him in God. Selah.
verses.web: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ فَتُرْسٌ لِي. مَجْدِي وَرَافِعُ رَأْسِي.
verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, [art] a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.web: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

verses.ar: بِصَوْتِي إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ أَصْرُخُ، فَيُجِيبُنِي مِنْ جَبَلِ قُدْسِهِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.web: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

verses.ar: أَنَا ٱضْطَجَعْتُ وَنِمْتُ. ٱسْتَيْقَظْتُ لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يَعْضُدُنِي.
verses.kjv: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
verses.web: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.

verses.ar: لَا أَخَافُ مِنْ رِبْوَاتِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱلْمُصْطَفِّينَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ حَوْلِي.
verses.kjv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set [themselves] against me round about.
verses.web: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

verses.ar: قُمْ يَارَبُّ! خَلِّصْنِي يَا إِلَهِي! لِأَنَّكَ ضَرَبْتَ كُلَّ أَعْدَائِي عَلَى ٱلْفَكِّ. هَشَّمْتَ أَسْنَانَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies [upon] the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.web: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

verses.ar: لِلرَّبِّ ٱلْخَلَاصُ عَلَى شَعْبِكَ بَرَكَتُكَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Salvation [belongeth] unto the LORD: thy blessing [is] upon thy people. Selah.
verses.web: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
